label: macOS IAC + Ableton Basic
requirements: Audio MIDI Setup with IAC Driver enabled
Ableton Live with the IAC bus enabled for Track and Remote input

inboundMidi: DAW or control-surface CC traffic on the same virtual port feeds the live slot-value lane

expectedTelemetry: Bridge console reaches device.ready after connect
Ableton sees incoming CC movement on the IAC bus
Round-trip p95 remains within the configured threshold during idle monitoring
manualValidationChecklist: Move one hardware knob and confirm a matching CC lane arrives in Ableton
Send one CC from Ableton and confirm the bridge logs a routed inbound command
Keep feedback suppression enabled unless intentionally testing loopback
